findings.explanation: HOL4 defines FAPPLY f x = OUTL (fmap_REP f x). Outside the domain this is OUTL (INR one). OUTL is introduced by new_recursive_definition (sumScript.sml:286), i.e. new_specification, with the single clause OUTL (INL x) = x, so its value on INR is left open. HOL4 only gives FAPPLY f x = FAPPLY FEMPTY x for x NOTIN FDOM f (NOT_FDOM_FAPPLY_FEMPTY), independent of x; no saved theorem equates it with ARB, an undefined constant (boolScript.sml:245). Lean's `none => ARB` branch proves FAPPLY FEMPTY x = ARB by rfl, and likewise FAPPLY f x = ARB for every x outside FDOM f.
findings.repair:
def OUTL_spec {β : Type u} {γ : Type v} (g : β ⊕ γ → β) : Prop := ∀ y, g (Sum.inl y) = y

def OUTL {β : Type u} {γ : Type v} [Nonempty β] : β ⊕ γ → β := Classical.epsilon (OUTL_spec (β := β) (γ := γ))

theorem OUTL_INL {β : Type u} {γ : Type v} [Nonempty β] : OUTL_spec (OUTL (β := β) (γ := γ)) :=
  Classical.epsilon_spec (p := OUTL_spec (β := β) (γ := γ)) ⟨fun s => match s with | Sum.inl y => y | Sum.inr _ => Classical.choice inferInstance, fun _ => rfl⟩

def FAPPLY {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [Nonempty β] (f : fmap α β) (x : α) : β :=
  OUTL (γ := Unit) (match f.rep x with | some y => Sum.inl y | none => Sum.inr ())

-- and finish the proof of FUN_FMAP_DEF with: simp only [FAPPLY, hx', if_true]; exact OUTL_INL _

import CandleLean.Prelude.FiniteMap

universe u v

theorem fapply_fempty_arb {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [Nonempty β] (x : α) :
    HOL.FAPPLY (HOL.FEMPTY : HOL.fmap α β) x = (HOL.ARB : β) := rfl
